story_text:
## Meet Aqualume
Your Own Little Landscape of Water, Light & Sound.
Bring a moment of calm to your everyday space. Aqualume combines a dynamic rainfall display, softly glowing mountain scenery, Bluetooth audio, nature sounds, and aromatherapy in one decorative desktop speaker. From your morning playlist to your evening wind-down, enjoy a little scenery that moves with your day.
## Watch the Rain. Feel the Calm.
Inside Aqualume, water continuously circulates to create a dynamic falling-rain effect.​
Tiny droplets move through the mountain-inspired scene while integrated LED lighting illuminates the landscape.​
Unlike a static decoration, Aqualume gives your desk something to watch, listen to, and experience.​
A little movement can change the mood of an entire room.​
## Mountain Views. A Gentle Glow.
Warm LED lighting traces the mountain contours, adding depth and a gentle glow to the miniature landscape.
Place Aqualume beside your bed or in a reading corner to create a cozy atmosphere for quiet evenings.
Use the night light independently, without rainfall or music, to accompany your bedtime routine.
## Your Favorite Music, with a View.
Connect your phone via Bluetooth to enjoy music, podcasts, or audiobooks through the built-in speaker.
Pair your favorite sounds with flowing water and soft light for a more atmospheric listening experience.
From focused work to quiet reading, Aqualume brings a personal soundtrack to your everyday moments.
## Nature Sounds. No Phone Needed.
Play rain, stream, and other nature sound recordings directly from a TF card.
Enjoy a soothing background for focused work, an afternoon break, or evening relaxation.
No phone connection is needed—simply choose your audio and settle into the moment.
## A Little Fragrance. A Fuller Experience.
Add a compatible water-based aroma oil to the water to bring a gentle fragrance into your space.
Pair your favorite scent with falling raindrops, warm mountain lighting, and soothing sounds.
Create a personal relaxation ritual for quiet breaks and unwinding at the end of the day.
## Flowing Water. Natural Evaporation.
As water circulates, natural evaporation releases a small amount of moisture into the surrounding air.​
This gentle process accompanies the flowing water, adding a subtle touch to your desktop environment.​
The amount of evaporation varies with room temperature and humidity.
## A Quiet Corner, Wherever You Are.
Place Aqualume beside your bed, on your desk, or in your favorite reading corner.
Moving water, glowing scenery, and built-in audio bring a calming atmosphere to everyday spaces.
A distinctive addition to your home—and a thoughtful gift for someone who enjoys a little everyday calm.

## TIMELINE
risks: Bringing Aqualume from prototype to the hands of our backers is an exciting journey, but like any hardware project, it comes with challenges.​ Manufacturing & Quality Control Aqualume combines electronics, lighting, a water-circulation system, speaker components, and a compact decorative structure in one product. Maintaining consistent quality across these different components during mass production requires careful assembly and testing.​ We are working closely with our manufacturing partners to establish production standards, perform quality inspections, and test key functions before shipment.​ Water Circulation & Electronics Because Aqualume combines water movement with electronic components, reliability and proper internal sealing are important priorities.​ Our design and production process includes testing the water-circulation system and checking for potential leakage or abnormal operation before products leave the factory.​ We will continue to refine the design and testing process throughout production to ensure a reliable user experience.​ Component Availability Some electronic and mechanical components may be affected by supplier availability or manufacturing lead times. If unexpected supply issues occur, production could take longer than originally planned.​ We are working with our suppliers in advance and will monitor component availability throughout the production process.​ Production & Delivery Moving from small-batch production to full-scale manufacturing can sometimes reveal unexpected issues, such as tooling adjustments, component delays, quality-control problems, or production scheduling changes.​ If any of these issues affect our timeline, we will communicate updates to our backers as early and transparently as possible.​ Shipping International shipping can involve customs clearance, carrier delays, weather conditions, and other factors outside our direct control.​ We will work with experienced logistics partners to coordinate fulfillment and provide updates whenever significant delays occur.​ Our Commitment We believe transparency is an important part of crowdfunding.​ Our goal is not simply to make Aqualume look beautiful in a campaign video — it is to deliver a product that works reliably and feels just as special when it arrives at your desk.​ We will continue testing, refining, and improving Aqualume throughout the production process, and we will keep our backers informed along the way.​ Thank you for joining us on this journey and helping bring Aqualume to life.

faq.a: Aqualume is a desktop Bluetooth speaker that combines a circulating rainfall display, warm mountain lighting, TF card audio playback, and aromatherapy in one decorative piece.

faq.q: How does the rainfall effect work?
faq.a: A built-in system circulates water from the reservoir to the overhead outlets, creating falling droplets that return to the reservoir.
Connect your phone via Bluetooth to play music, podcasts, or audiobooks through Aqualume’s built-in speaker.

faq.q: Can I use the night light independently?
faq.a: Yes. The warm LED night light can be used on its own, so you can enjoy the illuminated mountain contours without running the rainfall display or playing audio.

faq.q: Can I add fragrance to the water?
faq.a: Yes. Use only a compatible water-based aroma oil suitable for the device, and follow the instructions provided. Avoid adding undiluted essential oils or other unsuitable liquids.
